metricDefinitions.falseNegatives: Expected findings without an exact detector, type, and range match; denominator is expectedFindingCount.
metricDefinitions.falsePositives: Actual findings without an exact detector, type, and range match; denominator is the two actual findings emitted per run.
metricDefinitions.incorrectRanges: A missing/extra pair with the same fixture, detector, and type but different ranges; denominators are expectedFindingCount and the two actual findings emitted per run.
metricDefinitions.policyCorrect: Exact-range true positives whose action matched the reviewed policy outcome; denominator is policyEvaluable.
metricDefinitions.negativeFixturesWithFindings: Expected-empty fixtures that emitted at least one finding; denominator is negativeFixtureCount.
